Assignment Question:
A local logistics company manages its daily fleet delivery operations using an automation system. The application relies on a class called DeliveryRoute to record route details. Each route tracks its uniquely assigned vehicle identifier and uses an internal ArrayList<Double> data member to store the individual delivery distances (in kilometers) traveled between different dropping locations during the day. The application needs to calculate the total mileage logged for a given route by summing up all the specific travel distances stored inside the ArrayList. However, prior to processing the computations, strict input parameters must be validated to prevent corrupted data logs.

o   ArrayList<Double> distanceList
·

o   void addDistance(double distance): Appends an individual travel distance value to the distanceList
o   double calculateTotalDistance(): Computes and returns the total sum of all delivery distances stored inside the distanceList

·      Every individual delivery distance value added to the list must be a positive number greater than zero.
If any validation condition fails, the program should display “Invalid Input”.

·       Line 1: vehicleId (String)
·       Line 2: n (int, representing the number of delivery distance entries)
